title: TAF10GridReading
description: Raw TAF10 low-voltage grid telemetry collected from smart meters and grid measurement points. The payload is published via MQTT (topic: taf10/grid/{gridNodeId}) and is used to identify load or feed-in peaks before triggering grid-protection switching actions.

gridNodeId.description: Grid node, feeder, or aggregation point identifier; matches GridNodeMasterData.gridNodeId.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the meter readout or aggregation cycle.

activePowerPlus.description: Active power consumed from the low-voltage grid in W.

activePowerMinus.description: Active power fed into the low-voltage grid in W, for example from photovoltaic systems.

voltage.description: RMS voltage at the measurement point in V.

current.description: RMS current at the measurement point in A.

location.description: Optional measurement point location. Overrides the grid node master-data location.
